messages:
dina_sales: TheraHealth wants to run a 45-day POC. asking for one-off pilot fee $5k + 8h onboarding. they redlined DPA to request 90d log retention (we default 30). need legal + finance callouts.
harry_legal: pls attach their redline. 90d is a material change; propose 30d default + paid addendum for extended retention. tighten subprocessors list.
nora_se: acceptance criteria: 2 endpoints at 1.5k rps, p50 <120ms. recommend optional dedicated pool for stable perf.
mike_finance: net terms: they want net45; finance wants net30 for pilots. convert credit: they asked full credit if converted within 90d. need approval for credit policy.
dina_sales: can we offer credit but limit to first invoice and require PO + signed orderform?
harry_legal: yes. propose clause: full credit to month1 if MSA executed within 60 days; 90 days possible with CFO sign-off. will draft redline.
procurement_bot: routing note: customer prefers DocuSign. need signer emails and billing contact.
contracts_bot: SOC2 summary available (internal link).
nora_se: SSQ flagged key-management Qs and VPC peering. HSM request would escalate. otherwise answerable. i'll fill infra answers by EOD.
dina_sales: orderform snippet to include optional line item: "Dedicated capacity: $1,200/mo" as checkbox.
mike_finance: optional capacity okay as add-on. i'll confirm net terms decision today.
harry_legal: uploaded redline to /sales/therahealth/poc/redline_2401234567.docx: defaults to 30d retention, data deletion timeline, subprocessors reduced, convert-credit clause (60d default, 90d with approval). also SLA note: no SLA for POC; production SLA negotiable.
dina_sales: scheduled call with customer 2pm to confirm credit window and retention.
procurement_bot: will prepare DocuSign envelope after final doc. need final file + signer list.
nora_se: SSQ infra answers uploaded to folder.
dina_sales: action items: harry finalize redline today, nora finish SSQ, mike confirm net terms, procurement_bot queue DocuSign once final. target: PO signed by Thu.
harry_legal: done 12: redline posted, comments inline.
dina_sales: thanks team. I'll update customer after 2pm call. :thumbsup:
